trap.label: tempo na if-clause
trap.wrong: If I will have time, I'll call you.
trap.right: If I have time, I'll call you.
trap.why: O aluno acha que o futuro precisa de will nos dois lados, como no português futuro; em inglês só no resultado.

opts: If it will snow, we stay.

fix.wrong: When she will arrive, I'll call.
If I'll see him, I'll tell him.
fix.right: If I see him, I'll tell him.

fix.wrong: If you don't hurry, you miss it.
fix.right: If you don't hurry, you'll miss it.

rewrite.answer: When I get home, I'll call.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “It's sunny. We'll go out.” com if
rewrite.answer: If it's sunny, we'll go out.

rewrite.prompt: Pergunta: “What will you do if it rains?” (corrija: What you will do...)
rewrite.answer: What will you do if it rains?
